Title: Scheduling section - set start and end dates
Preconditions: PAGE-4 seeded or PAGE-1 available in Draft
Steps:
[NAV] Open PAGE-4 (or PAGE-1) from the Draft list
[WAIT] Page detail blade slides in and settles (a click during the slide-in animation can race and time out)
[ACT] Expand the Scheduling section
[WAIT] Start date / End date fields are visible
[ACT] Click the Start date field (data-test-id 'dp-input', a readonly @vuepic/vue-datepicker input wrapped by vc-shell VcDatePicker — it does not accept typed/keyboard input)
[WAIT] Date picker calendar popup opens (a day grid; each day cell has data-test-id 'dp-YYYY-MM-DD')
[ACT] Click the target Start day cell (e.g. data-test-id 'dp-2026-08-01') — clicking a day auto-applies the date, there is no separate confirm/OK button
[WAIT] Popup closes; Start date field shows the selected date
[ACT] Click the End date field ('dp-input')
[WAIT] Its calendar popup opens
[ACT] Click the target End day cell
[WAIT] Popup closes; End date field shows the selected date
[ACT] Click Save
[WAIT] Save completes
Assertions:
Start date field shows the selected day immediately after its calendar popup click
End date field shows the selected day immediately after its calendar popup click
Save persists both dates — reopening the page shows the same Scheduling values
Page shows Scheduled badge in grid after publish
Cross_Layer_Checks: [CONSOLE] no JS errors while opening either calendar popup or clicking a day cell
Failure_Signals: Clicking the 'dp-input' field does not open the calendar popup; clicking a day cell does not apply the date or close the popup; Save does not persist the selected dates; Scheduled badge missing from the grid after publish
Cleanup: Restore PAGE-4's original scheduling dates (see test-data/cms/pagebuilder-pages.md) if this run used the shared PAGE-4 fixture rather than a disposable page
References: C415395 C415396 C415397 C415398; automatability confirmed live 2026-07-21 (REG-2026-07-21-1438 triage) — the field is a clickable DOM calendar popup (@vuepic/vue-datepicker), not a native OS date picker; selectors: 'dp-input' trigger, 'dp-YYYY-MM-DD' day cells
